Changes: customer displays removed; only id, vendor, name, font A/B columns, nominal paper width, code pages (Unknown and repeated names dropped), cut, drawer pulse, QR, barcode and Star-command flags kept; field names and layout changed. "generic" and "manual" profiles are this project's own.

profiles.name: ESC/POS 80 mm, 48 columns
profiles.notes: Most 80 mm thermal printers at 203 dpi (576 dots, 12x24 font).

profiles.name: ESC/POS 80 mm, 42 columns
profiles.notes: 80 mm printers at 180 dpi (512 dots), e.g. Epson TM-T88 family, or 48-column printers set to 42.

profiles.name: ESC/POS 58 mm, 32 columns
profiles.notes: 58 mm printers (384 dots). Many have no cutter and no drawer port: feed only.

profiles.name: ESC/POS 76 mm impact, 40 columns
profiles.notes: Dot-matrix receipt printers (Epson TM-U220 class). No native QR or barcode.

profiles.name: Star Line Mode 80 mm, 48 columns
profiles.notes: Star TSP650/TSP700/TSP800 class in Star Line Mode (native).

profiles.name: Star Line Mode 58 mm, 32 columns
profiles.notes: Star 58 mm printers in Star Line Mode (native).

profiles.name: Plain text, 80 columns
profiles.notes: Line printers and the Windows "Generic / Text Only" driver: text and line feeds only.

profiles.name: Plain text, 40 columns
profiles.notes: Narrow line printers and text-only drivers: text and line feeds only.

profiles.vendor: YHDAA Shenzhen Yuhengda Technology Co., Ltd.
profiles.name: YHD-8390
TSP100 / TSP143 (up to III)
profiles.notes: futurePRNT raster-only printer: no ESC/POS and no Star Line text mode. Use the Star driver through the OS spooler with a rendered (PDF/bitmap) receipt.

profiles.name: mC-Print3
profiles.notes: StarPRNT; Star Line Mode compatible for text, cut and drawer.

profiles.name: XP-58
profiles.notes: Most XP-58 units have no cutter; some revisions lack QR.
